# FQHECylinderQuasiholeMatrixElements

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnCylinder` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnCylinder/FQHECylinderQuasiholeMatrixElements`

```text
FQHECylinderQuasiholeMatrixElements, version 0.01

Usage: FQHECylinderQuasiholeMatrixElements [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -l, --nbr-flux : number of flux quanta (default value = 9)
    -p, --nbr-particles : largest number of particles to consider. If negative, consider all the possible number of particles compatible with the number of flux quanta and the clustering properties  (default value = -1)
    --fix-nbrparticles : if positive, only consider a given number of particles (default value = -1)
    --aspect-ratio : aspect ratio of the cylinder (default value = 1)
    --cylinder-perimeter : if non zero, fix the cylinder perimeter (in magnetic length unit) instead of the aspect ratio (default value = 0)
    --offdiagonal-density : if non-zero, compute all the density terms c^+_{m+x}c_m, with x lower or equal to the provided value (default value = 0)

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

output options:
    --enable-ascii : store the files both in binary format and text format
    --disable-directory : do not create a directory to store the data
    --show-admissible : show the admissible configurations

precalculation options:

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
